name: Sesid
description: Sesid, the homeworld of the Draedan species, was an aquatic planet located in the Outer Rim Territories. It was a popular tourist destination, and many vacationers traveled across the galaxy to visit its tropical islands. The Galactic Empire conducted pharmaceutical research on Sesid, and deployed a military garrison on the scenic world to protect their assets.
